issues.jp_before: 父[ちち]{に/から|ni-source}自転車[じてんしゃ]{を|o-object}買[か]ってもらいました。
issues.problem: English 'I had my father buy me a bicycle' implies causation the Japanese favour construction does not carry.
issues.action: English changed to 'My father bought me a bicycle.'

issues.jp_before: 休[やす]んだ日[ひ]{の|no-possessive}ノート{を|o-object}クラスメート{に/から|ni-source}借[か]りました。
issues.action: English changed to 'I borrowed notes from a classmate for the day I was absent.'

issues.jp_before: 私[わたし]{は|wa-topic}図書館[としょかん]{の|no-possessive}人[ひと]{に/から|ni-source}探[さが]していた本[ほん]{を|o-object}借[か]りました。
issues.problem: Unnatural: you borrow from the library (図書館で), not personally from the library staff; also a second sentence starting with 私は.
issues.action: Replaced with 隣の席の人に/から消しゴムを借りました (same skill, f=2).

issues.jp_before: 急[きゅう]な質問[しつもん]{に|ni-reason}困[こま]りました。
issues.problem: English 'at a loss at the sudden question' is clumsy.
issues.action: English changed to 'The sudden question left me at a loss.'

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{の|no-possessive}態度[たいど]{に|ni-reason}腹[はら]{が|ga-subject}立[た]ちました。
issues.problem: Distractor が is acceptable colloquially (彼の態度が腹立つ).
issues.action: Distractor が replaced with へ.

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{の|no-possessive}失礼[しつれい]な言[い]い方[かた]{に|ni-reason}怒[おこ]りました。
issues.problem: Distractor を is not plainly wrong: 〜を怒る (scold someone for) is possible.
issues.action: Distractor を replaced with へ.

issues.jp_before: 先月[せんげつ]{の|no-possessive}電気代[でんきだい]{の|no-possessive}高[たか]さ{に|ni-reason}びっくりしました。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of 値段の高さにびっくりしました.
issues.action: Replaced with 彼の日本語の上手さに感心しました (same skill, f=2).
